upstream.description: A practical collection of plug-and-play starter blueprints for building autonomous AI apps with real APIs. Discover ready-to-build agent workflows, API stacks, architecture patterns, prompts, and monetization ideas for research agents, lead gen systems, SEO automations, MCP toolchains, and more.

classification.analysis: A curated collection of starter blueprints for building autonomous AI agent products, covering verticals like research, lead-gen, SEO content, social listening, outreach, real estate, and job hunting. Each starter bundles a README (product concept), architecture.md, prompts.md, and stack.md pointing to recommended third-party APIs (mostly Apify scrapers). It targets founders, agencies, and indie hackers who want opinionated MVP direction rather than raw code, and is itself mostly documentation with affiliate-linked API recommendations.

use_cases.title: Bootstrap a research or competitor-intel agent MVP
Find a stack and prompt pattern for a lead-gen or outreach agent
Reuse architecture notes for a multi-agent ops/orchestration system
Scaffold an SEO content or social-listening agent product
